title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

          properties:
            id:
              title: ID

              type: integer
              format: int32

            displayName:
              title: Display name

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last

                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes

                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) that the
                business-day-adjusted registration date falls in (e.g. 'FY26' for a
                registration date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Derived from
                the owner's own registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year carried by the
                business-day-adjusted registration date. Derived from the owner's own
                fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2

              title: Locality

                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',

                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA

              type: string

              description: >-

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              title: Possible duplicate of

              format: int32

              type: string

            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit

              title: Age band

I now have a thorough map. Here are my findings.

## Summary of current behavior

The codebase is the Spring Petclinic REST sample. There is **no `memberId` field in the production code** — `memberId` appears only in the acceptance test (`AcceptanceTest.java`), which describes a *future/target* unification of `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId = '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'`. The current production code still exposes `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `fiscalYear`, and `checkDigit` as **separate** derived values. All identity logic lives in the `Owner` entity and the V1 owner controller.

---

## 1. Entity / model class declaring the fields

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** — the single domain class carrying all of this.

- Line 75-76: stored field `@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;` (the only persisted one of this group). Getter/setter lines 189-195.
- Line 78-79: `householdId` (hash-derived), 81-82 `namesakeCount`, 84-88 `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf`, 93-94 `membershipLevel`.
- Lines 285-292 `fiscalYearOf(LocalDate)` — private static: fiscal year starts 1 July, identified by calendar year it ends in (`month >= 7 ? year+1 : year`).
- Lines 294-306 `@Transient getFiscalYear()` — formats `FY%02d` from `fiscalYearOf(registrationDate) % 100`.
- Lines 308-320 `@Transient getMembershipNumber()` — `'<customerCode>-M<YY>'` (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26`); null until both customerCode and registrationDate set.
- Lines 322-351 `@Transient getCheckDigit()` — the **Luhn** implementation: iterates customerCode digits right-to-left, doubles every second digit (subtract 9 if >9), returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`.
- Lines 428-441 `@Transient getLocality()` — the "**owner segment / region**" source: the `<REGION>` substring of customerCode before the first `'-'` (`'UNKNOWN'` if no code).
- Lines 443-451 `REGION_TIMEZONE` map (NSW/VIC/QLD → Australia timezones); 453-462 `getTimezone()`.
- Lines 464-478 `@Transient getOwnerSegment()` — `'<TIER>_<AREA>'`: TIER=PREMIUM if membershipLevel≥3 else STANDARD; AREA=METRO if locality is a known region else REGIONAL.
- Lines 480-495 `@Transient getIdentityKey()` — **SHA-256 identity computation**: `sha256Hex('<telephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>')` via `HashUtils`.
- Lines 497-563 Soundex helpers (`getLastNameSoundex`, `soundex`, `soundexDigit`).
- Lines 352-426 membership points/level derivation (tenure uses elapsed fiscal years, line 377-378).

---

## 2. Classes that compute / generate the values

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — the generator / collision handler.

- Lines 176-182 `REGION_POSTCODES` map (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); 188-192 `CITY_REGION` map (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD).
- Line 279 (inside `addOwner`): `owner.setCustomerCode(generateCustomerCode(...))`.
- Lines 703-736 `generateCustomerCode(postcode, telephone, lastName)` — builds `'<REGION>-<HASH8>'` (region from postcode, HASH8 = first 8 upper-hex of SHA-256 of `telephone + lastName`). **Collision handling**: if baseCode already used by another owner, append `'-<n>'` with smallest n≥2 that is unique (lines 728-735).
- Lines 738-759 `regionForPostcode(postcode)` — maps postcode to region via `REGION_POSTCODES`, else `'UNKNOWN'`.
- Lines 761-772 `regionForCity(city)` — via `CITY_REGION`.
- Lines 774-785 `hashHex(input, length)` — first `length` upper-hex chars of `HashUtils.sha256Hex`; used for HASH8 (8) and householdId (12).
- Lines 552-572 `validatePostcode(postcode, region)` — enforces postcode falls in region's range.
- Lines 899-923 `rejectDuplicateIdentity(owner)` — hard-duplicate rejection on exact `identityKey` match (409 via `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException`).
- Lines 925-966 `applyPossibleDuplicate(...)` — soft duplicate flag on soundex(lastName)+postcode match.
- Lines 968-995 `cappedMembershipLevel(...)`; 997-1009+ `computeHouseholdId(...)` (SHA-256-derived, 12 hex chars).

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/HashUtils.java`** — shared SHA-256 helper.
- Lines 41-53 `sha256Hex(String)` — full 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes. Doc (lines 24-27) notes it backs `identityKey`, `householdId`, and the `customerCode` hash segment.

---

## 3. Audit record classes / logic referencing the fields

All inside **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**:
- Lines 282-284: `AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}", ...)` — human-readable audit line including `customerCode` and `membershipNumber`.
- Lines 340-358 `emitOwnerCreatedEvent(owner)` — emits structured JSON audit event.
- Lines 360-371 `primaryIdentifier(owner)` — returns `owner.getCustomerCode()`; doc explicitly flags this as the single place to change when customerCode is unified into memberId.
- Lines 373-391 `record OwnerCreatedEvent(int seq, Integer ownerId, String customerCode, Integer membershipLevel, String event)` — serialized field order `{seq, ownerId, customerCode, membershipLevel, event}`, event discriminator `'OWNER_CREATED'`.

Test-side audit capture: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`** — captures the `AUDIT` logger via a Logback ListAppender (no direct field references, but it is how these audit events get asserted).

---

## 4. "Owner segment" concept

- `Owner.java` lines 464-478 `getOwnerSegment()` (see §1).
- `openapi.yml` lines 2304-2314 `ownerSegment` schema (TIER_AREA, PREMIUM/STANDARD × METRO/REGIONAL).
- Related region/locality concept: `Owner.getLocality()` (lines 428-441), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (448-451).

---

## 5. DTOs, request/response objects, mappers

- DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are **generated at build time from OpenAPI** — no `OwnerDto.java` exists in source. The authoritative source is **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**:
  - Line 2198-2209 `customerCode` (`'<REGION>-<HASH8>'`, readOnly, example `NSW-1A2B3C4D`).
  - Line 2210-2220 `fiscalYear` (`FY<YY>`, example `FY26`).
  - Line 2221-2230 `membershipNumber` (`'<customerCode>-M<YY>'`, example `NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26`).
  - Line 2231-2241 `householdId` (12 hex SHA-256).
  - Line 2277-2285 `locality`; 2286-2295 `timezone`; 2304-2314 `ownerSegment`.
  - Line 2352-2364 `identityKey` (lower-case hex SHA-256 of `tel|email|soundex`).
  - Line 2365-2374 `checkDigit` (Luhn 0-9, example 7).
  - Lines 2124-2128 postcode/region validation note.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — MapStruct mapper Owner ↔ OwnerDto/OwnerFieldsDto. No explicit mapping for these derived fields (they map by getter name automatically); line 50 ignores `postcode` on inbound `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`.

---

## 6. Test files

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`** — the only `memberId` reference anywhere. Lines 7-9 doc: target unified `memberId = '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'`. Lines 13-20 `coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId()` asserts `memberId` starts with `NSW`, contains HASH8 of `telephone+lastName`, and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are **removed**. This test encodes a not-yet-implemented change (current API still returns the old fields).
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`** — shared harness replicating the algorithms:
  - Lines 227-237 `CITY_REGION`, `REGION_TIMEZONE`, `REGION_POSTCODES` pinned tables.
  - Lines 244-265 `region()`, `timezone()`, `validPostcode()`, `knownOwner()`.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when the
                postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's
                normalized telephone followed by the last name. Assigned at creation
                time; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) that the
                business-day-adjusted registration date falls in (e.g. 'FY26' for a
                registration date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Derived from
                the owner's own registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year carried by the
                business-day-adjusted registration date. Derived from the owner's own
                fields at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; the
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} endpoint flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived from the owner's own id; null until the owner has
                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array

        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer

          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:

        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content

    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields

        detail:

          readOnly: true
        timestamp:

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with no
                separators, unifying the former customer code and membership number.
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range); FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (which starts on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date; HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalized telephone followed by the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation time and carrying no sequence
                number; a value that collides with an existing owner's is de-duplicated by
                appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment carried by the owner's member id (the fiscal year,
                which starts on 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registration date
                baked into the member id at creation time; e.g. 'FY26' for a registration
                date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Read back from the member id.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the customer code: its '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained
                in the owner's customer code. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; the
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} endpoint flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived from the owner's own id; null until the owner has
                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      parameters:

          in: header
          description: >-

            instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with no
                separators, unifying the former customer code and membership number.
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range); FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (which starts on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date; HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalized telephone followed by the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation time and carrying no sequence
                number; a value that collides with an existing owner's is de-duplicated by
                appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment carried by the owner's member id (the fiscal year,
                which starts on 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registration date
                baked into the member id at creation time; e.g. 'FY26' for a registration
                date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Read back from the member id.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the member id: its leading '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained

              type: string

              readOnly: true

              readOnly: true

              description: >-

                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

```
AUDIT - Owner created: id=11 memberId=NSW2716E6609E1 registrationDate=2026-10-05 membershipLevel=1

That `memberId` decodes exactly as specified: `NSW` (region) · `27` (FY, Oct 2026 → fiscal year ending 2027) · `16E6609E` (HASH8 over telephone+lastName) · `1` (Luhn check digit over the digits of `NSW2716E6609E`).

## What I changed

**`model/Owner.java`**
- Replaced the stored `customerCode` field/column with `memberId` (`@Column(name = "member_id")`) plus a private `memberIdBase()` that strips any `-<n>` collision suffix.
- Removed `getMembershipNumber()` and `getCheckDigit()`.
- `getFiscalYear()` now reads the `FY` segment back out of the member id (returns `FY<YY>`), rather than recomputing from `registrationDate`.
- `getLocality()` now parses the leading `<REGION>` segment out of the member id (feeds `getOwnerSegment()`).

**`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**
- Replaced `generateCustomerCode(...)` with `generateMemberId(postcode, telephone, lastName, registrationDate)` building `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, with collision de-duplication now applied to the `memberId`.
- Added private `fiscalYearOf(LocalDate)` and `luhnCheckDigit(String)` helpers.
- Audit line and the structured `OwnerCreatedEvent` record now carry `memberId`; `primaryIdentifier()` returns `getMemberId()`.

**`resources/openapi.yml`** — replaced the `customerCode`/`membershipNumber`/`checkDigit` schema properties with a single `memberId`; updated `fiscalYear` and `locality` descriptions to reference the member id.

**`resources/db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — renamed the `customer_code` column to `member_id` (widened to `VARCHAR(32)` to hold the longer `UNKNOWN`-region form plus any collision suffix).

**`util/HashUtils.java`** — doc comment updated to reference the member id's HASH8 segment.

The acceptance test `coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId` passes (region prefix + HASH8 present, old fields gone), and the full suite builds green.
